verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Godot publishes a per-class API reference (the EditorScript and EditorInterface class pages), and EditorScript lets users run ad-hoc scripts inside the editor via File > Run, a workaround for trying API calls. Nothing shows the reference itself is interactive or embeds runnable examples, and the probes found no llms.txt or .md mirrors for machine-friendly exploration. missing for 10: interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable examples embedded in the reference, machine-readable docs (llms.txt/.md), independent corroboration of example quality.
